places.name: The Campsite
places.note: Tents, a fire ring, and a sign about raccoons.

places.name: The Old Giants
places.note: Trees older than anyone remembers. Nobody brings an axe here.

places.name: Fairy Ring
places.note: A ring of mushrooms, glowing softly. Sarah does not step inside. Just in case.

places.name: Mossy Hollow
places.note: Soft green moss everywhere. It is very quiet here.

places.name: Whispering Glade
places.note: At dawn the wind in the leaves sounds like someone almost saying your name.

places.name: Fern Grotto
places.note: In the rain the ferns stand up tall and the whole glade smells green.

places.name: Owl's Roost
places.note: Something up in the dark branches says "hoo." Sarah says "hi."

places.name: Bluebell Dell
places.note: Bluebells, as far as you can see. Which is about twelve feet. Still.

places.name: The Cascade
places.note: Waterfall after waterfall, all the way down the mountain.

places.name: Mountain Lake
places.note: A still lake high on the mountain. The sky is in it twice.

places.name: Misty Ledge
places.note: The cloud comes right down to the path. Sarah is, briefly, in the sky.

places.name: Eagle Rock
places.note: A big flat rock with the whole island below it.

places.name: The Summit
places.note: The top of the island. Everything is down from here.

places.name: Snowy Peak
places.note: Snow on the summit, and not a single footprint but Sarah's.

places.name: Moonlit Bay
places.note: The moon on the water, and the whole north sea quiet.

places.name: The Beacon
places.note: At night the lighthouse beam sweeps right over Sarah's head.

places.name: Sunrise Shore
places.note: The sun comes up out of the sea right here. Worth the early alarm.
